column1: # Names for the symbols of the Abacus specification language, in Abacus's own
# vocabulary: the way the language talks about them (`\the` for the definite
# description ℩, `\some` for the choice operator ε, `\restrict` for ↾), plus
# the short conventional spellings of the built-in logic and set notation.
# Greek letters are left to the `greek` scheme.
# `$0` among the code points marks where the cursor goes, between a pair.
